answer: One concrete defense: bonded identity with peer vouching. An agent posts a slashable bond and hardware attestation before payment, and two staked agents must vouch for it, forfeiting part of their bonds if it is later slashed for collusion. Rewards vest across epochs, so a sparrow cannot appear, farm one round, and vanish. Sybil cost scales with capital and hardware, not cheap keys. Graph analysis clusters agents sharing funding, timing, or identical transaction shapes; dormant accounts across the tundra are pruned, and one canyon of correlated wallets is enough to slash the set.
